Defining Adequate Achievement

What is grade level achievement?

Normative Normative achievement is well understood. For
example, “on grade level” often refers to median
performance on a widely adminstered test.
Criterion Referenced Criterion referencecd achievement is
achored to statewide performance standards. For
example, on grade level achievement refers to
performance at least at the proficient level.
